name: irreversible-guard
description: PreToolUse gate that blocks shell commands with no practical local undo across Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), Grok, and Muse — de-obfuscates ssh/docker-exec transports, heredocs, command chains, and env prefixes, then matches a tiered deny-set (irreversible-everywhere ops block unconditionally; locally-reversible ops block only when the command names production)
